name: BidPackageLevelingBoard
tagline: Level construction bids like-for-like and award with confidence – inside Power Apps.
description: A complete preconstruction bid leveling app for general contractors and construction managers. Record bids per trade package, mark every scope item as included, excluded or qualified, plug the gaps at estimate, accept alternates and compare normalised totals against budget and each other. The app ranks bidders, flags spreads, expired validity and unqualified bidders, recommends the lowest compliant bid and runs the shortlist → recommend → award workflow with reasons, undo and buyout tracking.
features: Scope inclusions / exclusions / qualifications per bidder
Normalised totals, rank, spread and budget variance
Status workflow with reasons, undo and close-out of losing bids
Bid due dates, reminders and validity warnings
Buyout summary: committed, forecast and savings
CSV export, search, filters, grouping, bulk actions
Demo mode with fictional construction data
